Messages.Author: Stefan Ferenci
Messages.Body:
The Good:

The American Invasion (Robyn, Dave, David, Ben S., Ben P., Matt H.,
Eric, Master J.D., Matt M., Jay, Mark,Brian, Oscar ; meeting you
guys/girls is always a blast)
Rava is back (missed him in Heidelberg)!
Mats, Hugh, Bunter, The Dürings, Attila, Milan, the german crowd, The
evil twins from Paris (S.L.&K.S.), Quines it´s people like you who make
this game so awesome.
Ivan from Spain playing anneke with SER and extortions
Jay getting his revenge for the 2003 ec finals (congrats man great game,
great deck, great player)
Bleedy, Bleedy- Blocky, Blocky- Puffy, Puffy
Me managing to get a warning before the finals started
Me having tons of luck at the qualifier
The Organizers: Gabor/Tibor overall good job
DJ Pussycat

The Bad:

Missing people (The Lasombra{a ec without you jeff! unimaginable! next
year no excuses}, LSJ {hope everything is fine scott})
Ivan from Spain playing Anneke with SER and extortions beeing my predator.
The Location: too small, too crowded, tiny tables
The Organisation: Day one was suppossed to start at 10.30 started at
12.30, qualifier finals ended at midnight
Changing the time limit of said finals right before the start of the final
me running out of luck during the ec.
Prize Support for the finalists (second place at the qualifier got 12
boosters)
The austrian pussycat

The Ugly:

The Judging (you would expect the Head Judge to have at least some
knowledge of the vtes and vekn rules, next time i´ll buy derek r. a
ticket to buapest)

s.

Messages.Author: Anthony Coleman
Messages.Body:
Stefan Ferenci wrote:
> The Good:
>
> The American Invasion (Robyn, Dave, David, Ben S., Ben P., Matt H.,
> Eric, Master J.D., Matt M., Jay, Mark,Brian, Oscar ; meeting you
> guys/girls is always a blast)

Had a blast in pickup games with these guys and probably the most
laughs ive had in a competitive game was with D Tatu during a 2 hour
mauling at the hands of a Slovakian player, good job it was a fun game
as I scored nothing in it, you truly are a whining shi... erm sorry a
Shining Whit Dave ;)

> Mats, Hugh, Bunter, The Dürings, Attila, Milan, the german crowd, The
> evil twins from Paris (S.L.&K.S.), Quines it´s people like you who make
> this game so awesome.

Agreed, also was great to meet and play with the Danish and Swedish
contingents.

> The Bad:

> The Location: too small, too crowded, tiny tables

And those damn stairs! Lots of decent eye candy though in the form of
'the blooddolls' as I think they were named

> The Ugly:
> The Judging (you would expect the Head Judge to have at least some
> knowledge of the vtes and vekn rules, next time i´ll buy derek r. a
> ticket to buapest)

I had no bad experiances with the judging, even when my prey in one LCQ
game decided to enact an extreem example of the bakija gambit (10 pool
*poof*) they knew the rules on that well enough (it wasnt actually
material however, as he was transfering to 1 pool to do it).

As ever it was great to meet up with those I only knew online, and
those I met at last years EC to play a few games/shoot the breeze,
shame we didnt get the poker going (or that I didnt hang around for it
to start) Friday night at the Marilyn club was pretty cool too, though
im not sure rolling in at 4 or 5am was the best preparation for the
Qualifier, in fact, I think I'll use that for my excuse for very bad
scoring all weekend :O)

See you next year,
Anthony (bunter)
